The '''Likum language''' is a [[West Manus languages|West Manus language]] spoken by approximately 80 people in western [[Manus Island]], [[Manus Province]] of [[Papua New Guinea]].<ref name=e25/> Its speakers also use [[Nyindrou language|Nyindrou]].<ref name=e25/> Likum is classified as "definitely endangered" by [[UNESCO]]'s ''[[Atlas of the World's Languages in Danger]]''.<ref>[http://www.unesco.org/culture/ich/index.php?pg=00206 UNESCO Interactive Atlas of the World's Languages in Danger] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100217175902/http://www.unesco.org/culture/ich/index.php?pg=00206 |date=2010-02-17 }}</ref> It has [[subject–verb–object|SVO word order]].<ref name=e25/>
